projectDescription: A Codex plugin that keeps project evidence, chat context, operator instructions, working hypotheses, and model assumptions in separate cognitive layers via a provenance classification frame and optional PreToolUse hook.
keyFeatures: Six-layer provenance classification system (L0–L3) for separating project evidence, conversation context, operator instructions, and model assumptions
Optional PreToolUse hook that re-surfaces the compact frame before matched write tools (apply_patch, Write, Edit)
AGENTS.md prelude detection — classifies leading runtime instruction-chain blocks as L2A regardless of displayed conversational role
Inline tagging system ([L1], [L1A], [L2], [L2A], [L3]) for marking non-L0 content in generated output
Three dossier modes (A/B/C) for mechanical edits, semantic reorganization, and promotion of shaping material
Decontamination rules for conversation residue, agent-control residue, version ghosts, and model-prior claims
Graceful fallback when frame.md is missing — emits a visible warning rather than failing silently
Standalone-skill legacy support via the standalone-skill-v1 branch
publicApiSurface: Use Canon Boundary Guard for this session. (natural-language invocation)
Use $canon-boundary-guard for this session. (direct skill invocation)
references/frame.md — compact provenance frame injected by the hook
plugin.json — plugin manifest (name, version, skills, hooks, interface)
